description: This source file defines a static class 'MinimalAllureResultsWriter' that generates minimal Allure test result JSON files for NUnit tests. It creates a summary JSON for a test with attributes such as test name, status, start and stop times, and some metadata labels, primarily for environments lacking full Allure output support.

methods.name: WriteResultForCurrentTest
methods.description: Generates a JSON file with minimal Allure test result info, including test metadata, outcome status, timestamps, and labels, for a specific test.

parameters.name: resultsDir
parameters.description: The directory where the result JSON file will be saved.
